services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Lynn Creek Marina is located on the beautiful Joe Pool Lake in Grand Prairie, Texas. Named after the former Congressman, Joe Pool Lake features lush, green, rolling hills in the springtime and 7,500 acres of flood-controlled water that keeps the lake full at all times. Joe Pool Lake is also a great fishing lake known for largemouth bass and white bass. The Marina offers 530 wet slips, fuel, pump-out, a full-service marine center, a dry storage facility, a restaurant, and even a driving range for the avid golfer! If you’re looking for a spot for your boat less than an hour from both Dallas or Fort Worth, Lynn Creek Marina is your spot to call home! We’re proud to share that Lynn Creek Marina

It is located on Joe Pool Lake, a 7,500-acre flood-controlled lake with lush green hills in spring.
